contexts.text: To act perfidiously () = contrary to truth Divine, or contrary to the laws of Divine order... To act perfidiously is a customary formula in the Word, and signifies, in the internal sense, to act contrary to the truth and good in Heaven. Illustrated.
An assembly of the perfidious () = those who falsify the Knowledges of good.
To act perfidiously () = contrary to revealed truths.
